body:
Hydroxyzine HCL worked for me for anxiety.
Before being prescribed hydroxyzine I was physically and mentally anxious all the time which led to depression and it was really a downwards spiral from there. Eventually I went to the doctor when I was 14 and they prescribed me 25mg Hydroxyzine. This worked for my teenage/freshman year anxiety.
They tried taking me off of it my sophomore year, but I went right back to my old habits of anxiety. To this day I am on 50mg of Hydroxyzine HCL.
